legal.draftNotice: Draft pending legal review. This text is not final yet.

controller.title: Who provides the service
controller.body: Luma is operated by [company name, tax id and address to be defined]. By creating an account you accept these terms.

service.title: What Luma is
service.body: Luma helps you discover nearby restaurants and shops, see their menus and deals, place orders and pick them up in store. Luma does not prepare or deliver products: each business is responsible for what it sells.

accounts.title: Your account
accounts.body: You must be of legal age and give true information. You are responsible for keeping your password safe. You can delete your account at any time from your Profile.

orders.title: Orders and prices
orders.body: Orders are picked up in store. The server computes the final price from the menu and the deals valid when you confirm; the business may reject an order. You pay on pick-up until online payment is available.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.body: Whoever registers a business declares they may represent it and that what they publish is true: name, address, location, hours, menu, prices and deals.

verification.title: Business verification and suspension
verification.body: Luma reviews businesses before showing them (legal data, tax id and documents) to prevent false information. It may ask for changes, reject or suspend a business that breaks these terms or receives well-founded reports, and tells the owner why.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Do not use Luma for fraud, fake orders, offensive content or to obtain other people's data. We may suspend accounts that do.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Luma works to keep information accurate, but each business's data is published by its owner. [Scope of liability to be defined with legal advice.]

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If we change these terms we will tell you in the app and, when the law requires it, ask for your acceptance again.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: [Company name, tax id, address and email to be defined], under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013.

data.title: What data we process
data.body: Email and password (encrypted), full name, mobile number, department and municipality of residence (the neighbourhood is optional), your orders, favourites and reviews and, only if you upload it and agree, a profile photo. We never ask for your address: orders are picked up in store. Luma never receives card, PSE or Nequi data.

purposes.title: What we use it for
purposes.body: Creating and protecting your account, handling your orders, sending you codes and service notices, verifying businesses and handling reports. We do not sell your data or use it for third-party advertising.

location.title: Your location
location.body: Only with your permission, to show you what is nearby. It is used on your device and in proximity queries; we keep no history of your locations. You can deny or withdraw the permission at any time.

sharing.title: Who it is shared with
sharing.body: The business you order from sees your order and the name you show, never your email, phone or identifier. Only the business preparing your order sees your profile photo, and only if you turn that option on. Online payments are processed by Wompi (Bancolombia), which receives your payment details directly on its page; Luma only receives the result. We use infrastructure providers (hosting and database) that process data on our behalf.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can access, update and correct your data, ask for proof of your consent, know how it is used, withdraw consent or ask for deletion, and complain to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC).

exercise.title: How to exercise them
exercise.body: From your Profile you can edit your data and delete your account. For other requests write to {{email}}; we answer queries within 10 business days and claims within 15.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: While you keep your account. When you delete it we erase your profile, favourites, reviews and files; orders are kept anonymised for the business's records.

security.title: Security
security.body: Encrypted connections, data access restricted per account, and private verification documents visible only to their owner and the review team.

minors.title: Minors
minors.body: Luma is for adults. If we learn an account belongs to a minor, we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We will tell you in the app before an important change takes effect.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: This policy applies to orders paid online in Luma. Orders with "Pay at pick-up" are paid directly in the store.

processor.title: Who processes your payment
processor.body: Online payments are processed by Wompi, from Bancolombia. You type your card, PSE or Nequi details on Wompi's page, never in Luma. Luma only receives the reference, status and amount of the payment.

cancellations.title: Cancellations
cancellations.body: You can cancel an order while the business has not accepted it. If you do not complete the payment within 15 minutes, the order is cancelled automatically. The business can cancel an accepted order giving the reason.

refunds.title: When we refund you
refunds.body: If you paid and the order is cancelled (by you before it is accepted, by the business, or because the payment arrived late), we refund the full amount to the same payment method. If you do not pick up a ready order, the business can mark it as not picked up and that order is not refunded.

timing.title: Timing
timing.body: Card payments are usually voided the same day. Other methods are refunded from the Wompi dashboard and the time depends on your bank. [Maximum times to be agreed with the payment processor.]

pickup.title: Pay at pick-up
pickup.body: If you choose to pay at pick-up, any refund is handled directly by the business.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any claim about a payment write to {{email}} with your order number. This policy will be reviewed with legal advice before launch (Ley 1480 de 2011, Colombian consumer statute).

how.title: How to delete your account
how.body: Open the app, go to Profile and tap "Delete account". We email you a code to confirm it is you; once you type it, the account is deleted right away.

what.title: What is deleted
what.body: Your profile (name, mobile, residence and photo), your favourites, your reviews, your notices and the files you uploaded. If you own a business, also its data, photos and verification documents.

kept.title: What is kept
kept.body: Orders and payments are kept without your name or contact details, because the business and the law need them for their accounts.

help.title: If you cannot open the app
help.body: Write to {{email}} from the e-mail of your account and we delete it for you within 15 business days.

discover.title: Discover on the map
discover.body: Find restaurants and shops near you and see which ones are open now.

promotions.title: Browse the deals
promotions.body: Discounts from businesses around you, with the final price in sight.

order.title: Order and pick up
order.body: Build your order, choose when to pick it up and pay in store.

verify.body: Complete your details and documents; our team reviews it before it goes live.

order.a: Open a business from the map or home, add products to the cart and choose pickup now or at a scheduled time. The business tells you when it accepts it and when it's ready.

pay.a: For now you pay at pickup, directly at the business. Luma never asks for card details.

cancel.a: Yes, while the business hasn't accepted it, from My orders. If it already did, message or call the business.

business.q: How do I register my business?
business.a: In Profile, tap “I have a business”. Fill in the details, hours, menu, legal data and documents, and send it for review. It's published once the team approves it.

review.q: How long does a business review take?
review.a: Usually a few working days. We let you know in Notifications; if something is missing you'll see what to fix.

notifications.q: Why don't I get notifications on my phone?
notifications.a: Check Profile > Notifications and that the phone allows Luma notifications. Promotions only arrive if you turned them on.

data.q: What data does Luma keep about me?
data.a: What the privacy policy explains: your account, orders, favourites and reviews. We never show your email or phone to other users.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: In Profile > Account, “Delete account”. For security you must have signed in recently. Your data and your businesses' data are deleted.

steps.message: From the number {{value}}, send the code {{code}} on WhatsApp to Luma support.
steps.noSupport: Luma's support WhatsApp is not set up in this version of the app (SUPPORT_WHATSAPP), so you cannot send the code from here. Your request waits for review: the team checks it by hand and lets you know.
steps.social: Post the code {{code}} in the bio or in a public post of this account. Once verified you can remove it.
steps.review: A person of the team checks it and we let you know with a notification.
steps.whatsappAuto: Send the message exactly as it is, from this number ({{value}}). Luma verifies it by itself in a few seconds.
steps.landline: This looks like a landline: it cannot send WhatsApp, so it is not verified and gets no badge. You can add a mobile with WhatsApp to verify it.
steps.websiteAuto: Publish a text file at {{url}} with one line saying exactly {{code}} and tap "Check now".
steps.autoOff: Automatic verification is off: your request waits in the team queue, and they let you know once it is verified.
steps.watchTimeout: We did not get your message in 2 minutes. If you sent it from this number, automatic reception may not be set up yet: your request waits for review by the team. You can also try again.

validation.personName: Write the name with letters only (2 to 60). Spaces, apostrophes ('), hyphens (-) and dots are fine. No numbers or emojis.
validation.businessName: Use 2 to 60 characters: letters, numbers, spaces and & ' - . , ( ). At least one letter and no emojis.
validation.legalName: Write the legal name as it appears on the RUT: letters, numbers, spaces and & ' - . , ( ), up to 150.
validation.legalRepName: Write the representative's name with letters only (2 to 120). Spaces, apostrophes, hyphens and dots are fine.
validation.displayName: Use 2 to 40 characters with at least one letter.
validation.productName: Write the product name, up to 80 characters.
validation.promotionTitle: Write a title of 3 to 80 characters with at least one letter.
validation.shortText: Check this text: it is too long or has no letters or numbers.
validation.address: Write the address with the street and the number (5 to 120 characters), for example "Calle 18 # 25-30".
validation.search: A search can have up to 80 characters.
validation.email: Write a valid email, for example name@mail.com.
validation.mobilePhone: Write a 10-digit Colombian mobile starting with 3, for example 300 123 4567.
validation.phone: Write a mobile (300 123 4567) or a landline with its area code (601 234 5678).
validation.instagram: Write your Instagram username: letters, numbers, dots and underscores, up to 30.
validation.facebook: Write the name of your Facebook page (what comes after facebook.com/).
validation.website: The address must start with https:// and be a public domain, for example https://mybusiness.co. Without https:// it cannot be verified.
validation.price: Write a price between $100 and $10,000,000, without decimals.
validation.nit: Check the NIT and its check digit, for example 800.197.268-4.
validation.datesOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.datesTooLong: A promotion can last up to a year.
validation.datesPast: The end date has already passed.
